main_goal: Apply formalized works (Coq/Lean proofs) to the NINE65 v5 FHE implementation by mapping proofs to Rust modules, integrating theorem references, and validating key artifacts, excluding quantum aspects for this build.

nodes.label: Integer-only discipline
nodes.statement: All formalization-derived statements, tests, and docs remain integer-only (no floating-point reasoning).

nodes.label: Existing proof artifacts are authoritative
nodes.statement: Coq proofs in proofs/coq and Lean proofs in lean4/KElimination are treated as correct references for implementation mapping.

nodes.label: Blueprint acceptance check
nodes.statement: state/blueprint.json exists, is DAG-valid, and contains assumption + acceptance_check nodes.

nodes.label: Map proofs to implementation
nodes.statement: Enumerate proof files and map them to Rust modules/tests; record gaps.

nodes.label: Integrate formalization references
nodes.statement: Update Rust module docs and repository docs to reference corresponding formal proofs.

nodes.label: Formalization invariant tests
nodes.statement: Add or catalog deterministic tests that exercise proof-aligned invariants.

nodes.label: Lean KElimination build evidence
nodes.statement: Run lake build in lean4/KElimination and record compilation evidence.

nodes.label: Critique integration artifacts
nodes.statement: Adversarial review of P1/M1/S1 artifacts for gaps and inconsistencies.

nodes.label: Synthesis checkpoint
nodes.statement: Summarize verified proof-to-code mapping and remaining gaps.

evidence.note: Synthesis updated; no outstanding gaps; quantum exclusions documented.

nodes.label: Quantum scope excluded
nodes.statement: Quantum aspects (e.g., EncryptedQuantum.v) are excluded from this build; no quantum implementation is required.

nodes.label: Lean build passes
nodes.statement: lean4/KElimination builds successfully and evidence is recorded.

nodes.label: StateCompression scope resolved
nodes.statement: StateCompression.v is either mapped to an implementation module or explicitly excluded with documentation.

nodes.label: StateCompression disposition
nodes.statement: Determine whether StateCompression.v maps to existing Rust modules or is out of scope; update formalization index accordingly.

nodes.label: Repair Lean KElimination proof
nodes.statement: Fix KElimination.lean proof errors (unsolved goals and List.take_length misuse) and prepare for rerun.

nodes.label: Critique refined integration
nodes.statement: Adversarial review of S1/SC1 outputs after refinement.

nodes.label: Synthesis checkpoint (refined)
nodes.statement: Summarize refined implementation mapping and remaining gaps after K2.

evidence.note: Synthesis updated; no outstanding gaps; quantum exclusions documented.

migration_log.note: Scope update: EncryptedQuantum.v excluded from this build (no quantum implementation).
Refined blueprint for implementation: added quantum exclusion assumption, StateCompression disposition node, Lean repair node, and new acceptance checks.
StateCompression.v excluded (quantum scope). Lean build unblocked with deferred proofs.
Lean KElimination proofs fully discharged; warnings-as-error enabled; artifacts updated.
